headline: Stranger Than Heaven January 15
title: Stranger Than Heaven Release Date January 15 | RGG Studio | Gaming News
video_script: Stranger Than Heaven from RGG Studio, the team behind Yakuza, launches on January fifteenth, twenty twenty seven. Sega confirmed the date with a new trailer. It comes to PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S, and will be available on Xbox Game Pass from day one. Will you play it day one? Comment below!
description: Stranger Than Heaven (RGG Studio, Sega) launches January 15, 2027 on PC, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, day one on Game Pass. Sources: Gematsu, RPG Site, Sega.
